Chapter 795: Chapter 13 World (Please Subscribe)_3

The Three Outer Domain Evil Gods were overjoyed upon hearing the news.

For the time being, let’s not talk about the secrets of the Tianqing World. They were quite envious of the Void Secret Realm that the Black Demon Pavilion Master was guarding.

However, since the Pavilion Master held the ‘key’ to that Secret Realm and wouldn’t lead the way, they definitely couldn’t enter it on their own.

Upon hearing this, the Black Demon Pavilion Master did not respond but continued to head towards the Tianqing World.

About the secret of the Tianqing World? Greatly enhancing the Origin Power of the World wouldn’t cost the Pavilion Master anything more, even if another Evil God knew of it.

As for that Void Secret Realm he was guarding? Even without the matter of the Tianqing World, the Pavilion Master was already planning to invite the other three Evil Gods inside.

...

In the tens of thousands of years, the Pavilion Master had explored that Void Secret Realm and had reached a bottleneck; from now on, it would be difficult to achieve anything there by his power alone.

Therefore, teaming up with the other three Evil Gods to explore was almost inevitable.

…

Soon,

The Pavilion Master and the Four Outer Domain Evil Gods stopped and gazed into the distance at the Tianqing World.

“Is that the world?”

“The Origin of the world is indeed abundant.”

“It looks delicious…”

The other three Evil Gods examined the Tianqing World closely; as Evil Gods, they naturally could sense the level of a world’s Origin Power.

And the Tianqing World, right now, definitely could be described as ‘succulent.’

“Black Demon, what should we do now?”

“Since you called us here, you command.”

The Three Outer Domain Evil Gods, though eager to devour the Tianqing World, also understood that forcing the Pavilion Master to call them meant it was no ordinary world.

And this collaboration was led by the Pavilion Master himself; they were just here to assist, tempted by the lure of the Void Secret Realm, they all kept to the rules.

“No need to approach that world, just attack from here.”

said the Pavilion Master. The Tianqing World itself, although filled with abundant Origin Power, was bound by its own world and couldn’t actively attack areas outside of itself.

In other words, they just needed to attack from a distance, and the Tianqing World would be a sitting target.

This was the confidence with which the Outer Domain Evil Gods dared to consume worlds; the world’s intrinsic source of Origin Power was definitely much greater than that of an individual Evil God.

But alas, the world couldn’t fight back on its own.

This was akin to the difference between herbivores and carnivores.

No matter how formidable the size of an herbivore, it couldn’t resist a carnivore.

“No problem.”

The three Evil Gods nodded.

…

Tianqing World.

In the depths of the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged, comprehending the Divine Ability ‘World’ imprint.

“Hmm?”

“The Pavilion Master is coming on his own initiative?”

Lin Yuan glanced outside the world.

With the statue imbued with power from the Pavilion Master, Lin Yuan could easily pinpoint the Pavilion Master’s location using Causal Sensing.

So, from the Pavilion Master starting his move to approaching the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan was acutely aware.

“And he brought three Evil Gods with him?”

Lin Yuan immediately sensed the aura of three Evil Gods outside the Black Demon Pavilion Master.

“Perfect.”

“I can try out the Divine Ability ‘World’.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if the Black Demon Pavilion Master hadn’t come, Lin Yuan was planning to try to activate the ‘World’ Divine Ability to familiarize himself with the control details.

Compared to experiencing the Divine Ability ‘World’, dealing with the four most powerful Outer Domain Evil Gods in this area, including the Black Demon Pavilion Master, was purely incidental.

As for exposing the secret of the ‘World’ Divine Ability? The strong beings in the Main Universe have avatars. Since Lin Yuan’s ‘World’ Divine Ability couldn’t completely kill the opponent, it was possible it would be discovered.

But those four Evil Gods outside? According to Lin Yuan’s Causal Sensing, the opponent didn’t have any avatars. As long as he completely eliminated them, there was no risk of exposing any secrets.

…

Deep within the Boundless Void.

The Outer Domain Evil Gods were also paying attention to the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the other three Evil Gods.

“The Black Demon Pavilion Master is really cautious, not planning to get close to the Tianqing World at all.”

“Naturally, inside Tianqing World lie great horrors. The ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ couldn’t even escape, so naturally, the Black Demon Pavilion Master will not underestimate it.”

“Indeed, attack from a distance, just wait until Tianqing World is breached, the great horrors within will naturally reveal themselves.”

The numerous Outer Domain Evil Gods were discussing swiftly, eagerly awaiting the scene after the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the other three Evil Gods tore open Tianqing World.

In the eyes of all the Evil Gods, the fate of Tianqing World was almost certain.

With the Black Demon Pavilion Master and three other powerful Evil Gods taking action and being so cautious, there was no possibility of Tianqing World escaping unscathed.

…

“Begin the attack.”

“Don’t hold back at all.”

Between the eighteen arms of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, terrifying energy fluctuations were subtly converging while he instructed his other three ‘friends’.

The four Evil Gods working together could completely tear open Tianqing World in no more than a moment with their full strength.

You see, previously just a power sculpture of the Black Demon Pavilion Master was able to tear a huge crack in the barrier of the Tianqing World.

Now personally taking action, and together with the other three ‘friends’, tearing open Tianqing World was nothing short of certain.

“That’s for sure.”

The three Outer Domain Evil Gods also quickly began to take action.

Even a lion using all its strength to hunt a rabbit, these Evil Gods, who had emerged from endless slaughters, naturally understood this principle.

However.

The next moment.

The gaze of the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the four Evil Gods changed.

The void was vast.

At this moment, they were no longer in the Boundless Void, but had come to another world.

“What is this??”

The face of the Black Demon Pavilion Master drastically changed, being in this world, he was completely unable to sense the aura of the Boundless Void, as if cut off.

The other three Outer Domain Evil Gods felt the same.

However.

Before the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the four Outer Domain Evil Gods could react.

The overwhelming force of the world crushed down, the physical souls of the four Outer Domain Evil Gods shook, with no power to resist, their consciousness plunged into darkness, and soon, together with the surrounding world, they all shrank into the Tianqing World.
